PRIME-2378 Moving to Ministry of Health Keycloak (#2294)

* WIP

* Working with `environment.prod.ts`

* Read client-level roles

* PRIME-2413 - add stanza to trigger moh keycloak pr builds based on label

* Move to username

* Associate with existing enrollment/site registrations

* Remove obsolete configuration

* Test GitHub Actions

* Address "ERROR: syntax error at or near "END""

* Should be consistent with whether option is clickable

* Use PRIME-specific BCSC IDP now available

* Get individual enrollment working

* Search by username for Site Registration

* Improve comments

* Allow majority of code to continue to expect IdentityProvider to equal "bcsc"

* Read HPDID from `bcsc_guid` token attribute

* fix blank agreement screen

* Revised fix for PRIME-2432

* Update document-manager

* fix test compile error

* fix unit tests

* Fixes needed with TypeScript upgrade

* Version changes due to Keycloak libraries upgrade

* Fix "Can't find stylesheet to import" error with new library versions

* Address errors like "BrowserslistError: Unknown version 92 of android"

* fix code-coverage issue

* Update document manager

add moh keycloak client name

* Implement PRIME-2442

* Update angular not to use cache to build

* Add KeycloakClientId to api backend

---------
